decision: Reuse the existing owned systemd supervisor and session-entry pattern for the existing current-NF4 V7 browser runner; no new model, browser or dependency implementation.

references.use: Own nonce/InvocationID-scoped stop, retained primary errors, source closure and PID/start/PGID/SID scans
Exact systemd and cgroup memory/swap/deadline readback
Owned process/session and durable pre-model actor intent
Existing unchanged ten-task V7 runner/wire/judges, via scripts/jev_native_v2_browser.py

scope: Only new owner/entry/pure tests. Existing model, source inventories, action selection, helper, clients, judges and resource floor remain unchanged. Pure tests establish ownership contracts, not actual browser or model success.
fresh_comfy_observer: Require a byte-pinned comfy_observer exact ref in plan sources. Use observe(expected_boot_id=...) for all host and Comfy observations. Only explicit http_idle or independently absent_confirmed admits work; every timeout, malformed or unknown observation refuses start or stops the authenticated owned unit. Keep the old guard solely for unit status and exception capture without mutation. Default dry does not load either probe.
